versions.content: Service Name So Ad_ Get Phys Addr Specification of Socket Adaptor AUTOSAR CP R19 - 11 63 of 147 Document ID 416 : AUTOSAR_SWS_SocketAdaptor - AUTOSAR confidential - Syntax Std_ Return Type So Ad_ Get Phys Addr ( So Ad_ So Con Id Type So Con Id, uint8* Phys Addr Ptr ) Service ID [hex] 0x0D Sync/ Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant Parameters (in) So Con Id socket connection index representing the So Ad socket connection for which the physical source address of the related Eth If controller shall be obtained. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) Phys Addr Ptr Pointer to the memory where the physical source address (MAC address) in network byte order is stored Return value Std _ - Return - Type Result of operation E_ OK The request was successful E_ NOT_ OK The request was not successful. Description Retrieves the physical source address of the Eth If controller used by the So Ad socket connection specified by So Con Id. Available via So Ad.h
